description:
No IO module. The only output primitive is Kernel.dbg's fz_dbg_value, which renders a value (runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:314-322) through ctx.output (runtime/src/output.rs:17-24, always appends newline). Add a primitive that writes a binary (String.Chars) to the same sink on all three paths, and lib/io.fz.

## Design review (2026-10-17)
Fold: Kernel.dbg is IO.puts(inspect(v)) returning v. One renderer (inspect, fz-sc8.10) and one output primitive (the binary-writing sink this ticket adds) replace dbg's private emit_print_line path (runtime/src/lib.rs:41-51, fz_dbg_value_ref ir_runtime.rs:314-322). Depends on fz-sc8.10 for the fold; IO.puts itself does not.
title: IO.puts/1 writes a string to stdout
